name: matched-ks3-all-output-lr3
hypothesis: Increase only active KS3 feedforward output-projection per-matrix learning-rate factors from the inherited2x to3x, retaining input factors1x and all original shape-based multipliers. Both dense and routed output matrices are zero-initialized in the pinned WR model, so their early updates control when input projections and learned geometry receive gradients. Test whether faster output adaptation helps; this is complementary to the isolated1x trial, not a uniform projection-rate change. Retained conventional MLPs keep original2x factors. Keep geometry Adam[.9,.99] at0.125, zero coefficients, widths1024/rank one, BF16/GS32, ANVIL/masterweights/cache equations, MoE8top1 and every shared/model-wide setting unchanged. Original effective-rate coupling to decay is preserved. Frozen research_optimizer output_projection_multiplier metadata is hard-coded2x; actual optimizer-derived coverage reports the effective3x policy.
